title: Intel Arizona Manufacturing Technician Apprenticeship Launch — Phase 65 TSMC Arizona delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the TSMC Arizona delivery reporting pack. Arizona records Intel's launch of a one-year registered apprenticeship for manufacturing facility technicians.
key_findings: Selected apprentices become full-time Intel employees on day one.
Successful completion is intended to produce a certificate and college credit.
The release plans dozens of apprentices over five years without reporting results.
why_it_matters: Which records separate campus construction, utility arrangements, workforce inputs, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It provides an employer-linked training design against which completions and retention can be checked.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The source record used for this dossier is an official state announcement, not an outcome report.
No completion, credential, retention, or placement result is disclosed.
